title.en: Volume 37 Treatises 12: Astronomy 12, Solar and Lunar Eclipses, Planetary Occultations and Approaches, Daytime Appearances of Venus, Solar and Lunar Anomalies
title.raw: 卷37 志十二 天文十二 日食月 五星凌犯掩距 太白昼见 日变月变

sentences.zh: 日食月五星淩犯掩距太白晝見日變月變

translations.literal: Solar and Lunar Eclipses; Lunar and Five-Planetary Crossing, Approach, Occultation, and Close Approach; Daytime Appearance of Venus; Solar and Lunar Anomalies.
translations.idiomatic: Solar and lunar eclipses; crossings, approaches, occultations, and close approaches of the moon and five planets; daytime visibility of Venus; solar and lunar anomalies.

sentences.zh: 日食三統、四分，皆有推月食術，而無推日食術。

translations.literal: The Triple Concordance and Quarter-Remainder [calendars] each have methods for predicting lunar eclipses, but none for predicting solar eclipses.
translations.idiomatic: Both the Triple Concordance and Quarter-Remainder systems could predict lunar eclipses, yet neither offered a method for solar eclipses.

sentences.zh: 由日食或見或否，或淺或深，隨地而變。

translations.literal: Because a solar eclipse may be seen or not seen, shallow or deep, it varies according to place.
translations.idiomatic: A solar eclipse may or may not be visible, and may be slight or deep, all depending on where one stands.

sentences.zh: 不詳其數，立術綦難。

translations.literal: Without knowing the numbers in detail, establishing the procedure is extremely difficult.
translations.idiomatic: Without precise parameters, devising a reliable method is exceedingly hard.

sentences.zh: 故自古以為尤異，每食，史冊必書。

translations.literal: Therefore from antiquity it has been regarded as especially portentous; at every eclipse the historical records must record it.
translations.idiomatic: Hence antiquity treated eclipses as singular omens, and every eclipse was entered in the annals.

sentences.zh: 後人推日食之術密矣，猶必書者，從其朔也。

translations.literal: Later men made the method for predicting solar eclipses exact, yet they still had to record them, following the precedent of the new moon.
translations.idiomatic: Later astronomers refined solar-eclipse prediction to great precision, yet still recorded each event—honoring the ancient practice tied to the new moon.

sentences.zh: 其見於本紀，無食分及所次宿，備以入誌，言推步者考焉。

translations.literal: Those appearing in the Basic Annals, without eclipse magnitude or the lodge where [the sun] stood, are fully entered in the treatise so that those who speak of calendrical computation may examine them.
translations.idiomatic: Eclipses noted in the Basic Annals without magnitude or lodge are gathered here in full for calendrical specialists to consult.

sentences.zh: 月五星淩犯掩距天官書言「相淩為鬥」，又云「七寸以內必之」，謂緯度相迫如交食也。

translations.literal: On lunar and five-planetary crossing, approach, occultation, and close approach: the Treatise on the Celestial Offices says, "Mutual crossing is combat," and also, "Within seven inches it is certain," meaning that latitude draws near as in an eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On crossings, approaches, occultations, and close approaches of the moon and five planets: the Treatise on the Celestial Offices calls mutual crossing "combat," and says events "within seven inches" are certain—when latitudes close as in an eclipse.

sentences.zh: 今法，兩星相距三分以內為淩，月與星相距十七分以內為淩，俱以相距一度以內為犯，相襲為掩。

translations.literal: By present method, two stars within 3 parts of each other count as crossing; moon and star within 17 parts count as crossing; both within 1 degree count as approach; mutual covering counts as occultation.
translations.idiomatic: Current practice: two stars within 3 arc-minutes are in crossing; moon and star within 17 arc-minutes likewise; within 1 degree is an approach; full overlap is an occultation.

sentences.zh: 欽天監每年預推月五星入此限者，繕冊進呈，本名淩犯書，雍正初年，改名相距書。

translations.literal: The Directorate of Astronomy each year pre-calculates the moon and five planets entering these limits, compiles a register and presents it; originally titled Book of Crossings and Approaches, in the early Yongzheng era it was renamed Book of Close Approaches.
translations.idiomatic: Each year the Directorate forecast moon and planetary entries within these bounds, bound them in a register for the throne—first called the Book of Crossings and Approaches, renamed the Book of Close Approaches in early Yongzheng.

sentences.zh: 既憑占候，即課推步，各循本稱，並誌所在之宿。

translations.literal: Since prognostication is relied upon, calendrical computation is then tested; each follows its proper designation, and the lodge where [the event occurred] is also recorded.
translations.idiomatic: Omens guided observation, observation tested the calendar: each event keeps its technical name, with the lodge noted.

sentences.zh: 太白見於辰、巳二位者，乾隆二年七月己亥、癸丑，八月甲子、癸酉、乙亥至己卯，癸未至乙酉，九月丁亥至辛卯、乙未、丁酉、庚子，甲辰至丙午，閏九月丙辰朔、辛酉、癸亥，十年七月壬申、戊寅至庚辰、壬午，十三年八月戊子、丙申至庚戌，九月乙卯氾丙辰、戊午、辛酉、丙寅至戊辰，十五年五月丁未、己酉、壬子、癸丑、戊午、己未，六月丙子、丁丑，俱卯、辰二時。

translations.literal: Those where Venus appeared in the chen and si positions: in the 2nd year of Qianlong, 7th month, days jihai and guichou; in the 8th month, days jiazi, guiyou, from yihai through jimao, from guiwei through yiyou; in the 9th month, from day dinghai through xinmao, days yiwei, dingyou, gengzi, from jiachen through bingwu; in the intercalary 9th month, new moon day bingchen, days xinyou and guihai; in the 10th year, 7th month, day renshen, from wuyin through gengchen and renwu; in the 13th year, 8th month, days wuzi, from bingchen through gengxu; in the 9th month, days yimao and bingchen, wuwu, xinyou, from bingyin through wuchen; in the 15th year, 5th month, days dingwei, jiyou, renzi, guichou, wuwu, and jiwei; in the 6th month, days bingzi and dingchou — all at the mao and chen hours.
translations.idiomatic: Venus spanning east and southeast (chen and si): Qianlong 2, month 7 (jihai, guichou); month 8 (jiazi, guiyou, yihai through jimao, guiwei through yiyou); month 9 (dinghai through xinmao, yiwei, dingyou, gengzi, jiachen through bingwu); intercalary month 9, bingchen new moon, xinyou, guihai; year 10, month 7, renshen, wuyin through gengchen and renwu; year 13, month 8 (wuzi, bingchen through gengxu); month 9 (yimao and bingchen, wuwu, xinyou, bingyin through wuchen); year 15, month 5 (dingwei, jiyou, renzi, guichou, wuwu, jiwei); month 6 (bingzi, dingchou) — all dawn and mid-morning (mao and chen hours).

sentences.zh: 太白見於未、申二位者，乾隆二年正月丙申至戊戌、癸卯，戊午至二月庚申、丙寅、戊辰、庚午，三年九月戊辰、己巳、辛未，五年五月辛亥，八年七月己丑、庚寅、壬辰、甲午、甲辰至丙午、戊申、己酉，十五年正月己酉，三十二年閏七月壬寅、癸卯、丙午至戊申、庚戌，壬子至乙卯、戊午、庚申，八月壬戌朔、丙寅、丁卯，俱申、酉二時。

translations.literal: Those where Venus appeared in the wei and shen positions: in the 2nd year of Qianlong, 1st month, from day bingshen through wuxu and guimao, from wuwu through the 2nd month, days gengshen, bingyin, wuchen, and gengwu; in the 3rd year, 9th month, days wuchen, jisi, and xinwei; in the 5th year, 5th month, day xinhai; in the 8th year, 7th month, days jichou, gengyin, renchen, jiawu, from jiachen through bingwu, days wushen and jiyou; in the 15th year, 1st month, day jiyou; in the 32nd year, intercalary 7th month, days renyin, guimao, bingwu through wushen, gengxu, from renzi through yimao, days wuwu and gengshen; in the 8th month, new moon day renxu, days bingyin and dingmao — all at the shen and you hours.
translations.idiomatic: Venus spanning southwest and west (wei and shen): Qianlong 2, month 1 (bingshen through wuxu and guimao, wuwu through month 2, gengshen, bingyin, wuchen, gengwu); year 3, month 9 (wuchen, jisi, xinwei); year 5, month 5, xinhai; year 8, month 7 (jichou, gengyin, renchen, jiawu, jiachen through bingwu, wushen, jiyou); year 15, month 1, jiyou; year 32, intercalary month 7 (renyin, guimao, bingwu through wushen, gengxu, renzi through yimao, wuwu, gengshen); month 8, renxu new moon, bingyin, dingmao — all mid-afternoon and evening (shen and you hours).

sentences.zh: 太白見於巳、未二位者，乾隆十年七月丙子、丁丑，俱卯巳二時。

translations.literal: Those where Venus appeared in the si and wei positions: in the 10th year of Qianlong, 7th month, days bingzi and dingchou — all at the mao and si hours.
translations.idiomatic: Venus spanning southeast and southwest (si and wei): Qianlong 10, month 7, bingzi and dingchou — all dawn and mid-morning (mao and si hours).

sentences.zh: 十三年八月辛亥，九月己未、辛未、甲戌、己卯，十五年四月庚子，五月乙巳，俱辰、午二時。

translations.literal: In the 13th year, 8th month, day xinhai; in the 9th month, days jiwei, xinwei, jiaxu, and jimao; in the 15th year, 4th month, day gengzi; in the 5th month, day yisi — all at the chen and wu hours.
translations.idiomatic: Year 13, month 8, xinhai; month 9 (jiwei, xinwei, jiaxu, jimao); year 15, month 4, gengzi; month 5, yisi — all morning and noon (chen and wu hours).

sentences.zh: 太白見於卯、辰、巳三位者，乾隆十年六月庚午，十五年五月丁巳，十八年六月癸巳、甲午，俱寅、卯、辰三時。

translations.literal: Those where Venus appeared in the mao, chen, and si positions: in the 10th year of Qianlong, 6th month, day gengwu; in the 15th year, 5th month, day dingsi; in the 18th year, 6th month, days guisi and jiawu — all at the yin, mao, and chen hours.
translations.idiomatic: Venus spanning east and southeast (mao, chen, and si): Qianlong 10, month 6, gengwu; year 15, month 5, dingsi; year 18, month 6, guisi and jiawu — all dawn through mid-morning (yin, mao, and chen hours).

sentences.zh: 太白見於辰、巳、未三位者，乾隆十三年九月癸丑、丁巳、壬戌、己巳、庚午，十五年五月壬寅，六月乙亥，十八年六月辛亥，俱卯、辰、午三時。

translations.literal: Those where Venus appeared in the chen, si, and wei positions: in the 13th year of Qianlong, 9th month, days guichou, dingsi, renxu, jisi, and gengwu; in the 15th year, 5th month, day renyin; in the 6th month, day yihai; in the 18th year, 6th month, day xinhai — all at the mao, chen, and wu hours.
translations.idiomatic: Venus spanning east, southeast, and southwest (chen, si, and wei): Qianlong 13, month 9 (guichou, dingsi, renxu, jisi, gengwu); year 15, month 5, renyin; month 6, yihai; year 18, month 6, xinhai — all dawn, mid-morning, and noon (mao, chen, and wu hours).

sentences.zh: 太白晝見不著位者，順治元年六月庚午，九月己酉，三年正月己未，六年八月甲午，七年十二月辛丑，康熙七年九月戊戌、己亥，二十一年十月乙未至戊戌，二十三年五月己卯至庚寅，俱不著時。

translations.literal: Daytime appearance of Venus with position not recorded: in the 1st year of Shunzhi, 6th month, day gengwu, and 9th month, day jiyou; in the 3rd year, 1st month, day jiwei; in the 6th year, 8th month, day jiawu; in the 7th year, 12th month, day xinchou; in the 7th year of Kangxi, 9th month, days wuxu and jihai; in the 21st year, 10th month, from day yiwei through wuxu; in the 23rd year, 5th month, from day jimao through gengyin — in all cases the hour was not recorded.
translations.idiomatic: Daytime Venus, position omitted: Shunzhi 1, month 6 (gengwu) and month 9 (jiyou); year 3, month 1, jiwei; year 6, month 8, jiawu; year 7, month 12, xinchou; Kangxi 7, month 9 (wuxu, jihai); year 21, month 10 (yiwei through wuxu); year 23, month 5 (jimao through gengyin) — times not recorded.

sentences.zh: 日變月變崇德七年四月庚戌，二日並出，上大下小，須臾大日散沒。

translations.literal: Solar and lunar anomalies: in the 7th year of Chongde, 4th month, day gengxu, two suns appeared together, the upper large and the lower small; in a moment the larger sun dispersed and vanished.
translations.idiomatic: Solar and lunar anomalies: Chongde 7, month 4, gengxu — two suns rose together, the upper large and lower small; presently the greater sun dispersed and set.

sentences.zh: 順治元年二月癸亥，月中有黑子。

translations.literal: In the 1st year of Shunzhi, 2nd month, day guihai, there was a black spot within the moon.
translations.idiomatic: Shunzhi 1, month 2, guihai: a black spot appeared in the moon.

sentences.zh: 七年三月己未，日赤如血。

translations.literal: In the 7th year, 3rd month, day jiwei, the sun was red as blood.
translations.idiomatic: Year 7, month 3, jiwei: the sun turned blood-red.

sentences.zh: 十一年四月庚申朔，日出時色變赤；

translations.literal: In the 11th year, 4th month, new moon day gengshen, at sunrise the color turned red;
translations.idiomatic: Year 11, month 4, gengshen new moon: at sunrise the sun's color turned red;

sentences.zh: 戊子，日色變白。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, the sun's color turned white.
translations.idiomatic: wuzi: the sun's color turned white.

sentences.zh: 十四年二月乙酉，日赤如血。

translations.literal: In the 14th year, 2nd month, day yiyou, the sun was red as blood.
translations.idiomatic: Year 14, month 2, yiyou: the sun turned blood-red.

sentences.zh: 康熙元年二月丁卯，日赤如血；

translations.literal: In the 1st year of Kangxi, 2nd month, day dingmao, the sun was red as blood;
translations.idiomatic: Kangxi 1, month 2, dingmao: the sun turned blood-red;

sentences.zh: 戊辰，日出色如血，無光。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, the sun emerged the color of blood, without light.
translations.idiomatic: wuchen: the sun rose the color of blood, without radiance.

sentences.zh: 十三年六月丙午，月生光一道，色蒼白。

translations.literal: In the 13th year, 6th month, day bingwu, the moon emitted a streak of light, pale in color.
translations.idiomatic: Year 13, month 6, bingwu: the moon sent forth a streak of light, pale white.

sentences.zh: 十九年四月己巳，日赤無光。

translations.literal: In the 19th year, 4th month, day jisi, the sun was red and without light.
translations.idiomatic: Year 19, month 4, jisi: the sun turned red and lost its light.

sentences.zh: 二十一年六月乙巳戌時，日射青氣二道。

translations.literal: In the 21st year, 6th month, day yisi, at the start of the xu hour, the sun shot forth two greenish rays.
translations.idiomatic: Year 21, month 6, yisi, start of xu hour: the sun cast forth two greenish rays.

sentences.zh: 乾隆八年三月辛巳，日赤無光。

translations.literal: In the 8th year of Qianlong, 3rd month, day xinsi, the sun was red and without light.
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 8, month 3, xinsi: the sun turned red and lost its light.

sentences.zh: 二十九年六月甲申，月見正午。

translations.literal: In the 29th year, 6th month, day jiashen, the moon was seen at noon.
translations.idiomatic: Year 29, month 6, jiashen: the moon appeared at noon.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬子，如之。

translations.literal: In the 11th month, day renzi, it was the same.
translations.idiomatic: Month 11, renzi: the same.

sentences.zh: 四十八年六月戊辰，日心中出白圈，向東成圍。

translations.literal: In the 48th year, 6th month, day wuchen, a white ring emerged from the sun's center and formed a ring toward the east.
translations.idiomatic: Year 48, month 6, wuchen: a white ring issued from the sun's center and arched eastward into a full ring.

sentences.zh: 五十八年正月壬子，日生赤黃色大半環及大圍圈各一。

translations.literal: In the 58th year, 1st month, day renzi, the sun produced one large reddish-yellow half-ring and one large encircling ring.
translations.idiomatic: Year 58, month 1, renzi: the sun formed a large reddish-yellow half-ring and a large full ring.

sentences.zh: 二月戊子，日生赤黃色大半環。

translations.literal: In the 2nd month, day wuzi, the sun produced a reddish-yellow large half-ring.
translations.idiomatic: Month 2, wuzi: the sun formed a large reddish-yellow half-ring.
